scope: Isolated browser with 150 synthetic results on two dates; pagination, search, updates, sorting, date expansion, row identity, unrendered score/name/metadata corrections, section changes, removal and reload persistence.
checks: The initial history retains all 150 results and displays 50 of the current day
Only the first 50 results have names, controls and cells at startup
Score, full-match, metadata and name updates retain an unrendered result without building cells
Searching a corrected hidden name builds only that result with its current score and metadata on the same row
Clearing search retains existing row and player nodes and leaves the other results unrendered
More results reveal the remaining current-day games on the same rows
The reduced view can be restored
Search finds a result beyond the initial page and from a collapsed day
Clearing search restores the reduced view
Opening another day reveals its first results instead of an empty group
A result updated outside the visible page retains its current score when shown
Sorting still includes all results
The all-results preference survives a page reload
Reopening an unrendered result removes its placeholder and creates one complete scheduled row
Finishing the reopened game shows the current result once without a stale placeholder
Removing an unrendered result removes its indexed placeholder
Twenty further results keep exactly 50 complete history rows and retain every older indexed row
A released result still accepts full score and name corrections without creating hidden controls
Revealing a released result reconstructs the corrected data on its original row
History pages leave no incomplete work or browser exceptions
